name: Cauliflower "Fried Rice" with Egg, Edamame & Carrot
instructions: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, place eggs, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Pour the egg mixture into the pot. Scramble using a combination of stirring and flipping, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the pan. Cook until the eggs are no longer runny. Transfer to a plate and set aside. (Reserve pot for the next step.)
Return the pot to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add riced cauliflower, carrots, edamame, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 6-7 minutes.
When the veggies are done, return scrambled eggs to the pot. Add stir-fry sauce, stir to combine, and continue to cook until warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide "fried rice" between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
